blocks.heading: Do the points ever expire?
blocks.text: Points do not expire as long as your account is open, active, and in good standing.

blocks.heading: Are there a maximum number of points I can earn during the year?
blocks.text: There is no limit on the number of points you can earn on purchases, as long as your account is open and in good standing.

blocks.heading: How do I contact Princess if I have questions about a cruise?
blocks.text: You can speak with a Princess Representative Monday through Saturday, 11:00 am – 8:00 pm ET by calling 1-800-774-6237 or by logging in to princess.com

blocks.heading: How do I earn points?
blocks.text: You can earn two points per $1 spent on Princess Cruise Line purchases including cruise bookings and onboard amenities; and 1 point per $1 on all other purchases made with your Princess Rewards Visa Card.

blocks.heading: How can I redeem my points?
blocks.text: You can redeem your points at any time online or by phone. To redeem online, log in to your account at BarclaysUS.com and click on the Rewards and Benefits link, then select Start using my Points at the top of the page. To redeem by phone, call the number on the back of your card to speak with a representative.

blocks.heading: What can I redeem points for?
blocks.text: Your points can be redeemed toward onboard credit and amenities, travel, gift cards and merchandise. You can also redeem points toward eligible purchases with Princess Cruises or other World’s Leading Cruise Lines, or an airline purchase that is equal to or greater than $50, that posts to the Account within 180 days.

blocks.heading: Will I lose my points if I close my account?
blocks.text: Points earned through the Princess Rewards Visa Card will be forfeited 90 days after a voluntary account closure.

blocks.heading: How can I track my points and redemptions?
blocks.text: Monthly Statement: Your monthly billing statement will display your points balance as of the end of the billing period, and you’ll see a summary of the net points you've earned and redeemed in that period. blocks.heading: What accessibility features are available on the ship?
blocks.text: Princess ships are designed to accommodate a wide range of accessibility needs, helping all guests enjoy a comfortable and seamless cruise experience. Accessibility features may include step-free access to many public areas, accessible staterooms, elevators throughout the ship and designated seating in select venues. blocks.heading: Are there wheelchair-accessible cabins available?
blocks.text: Yes, Princess offers a selection of wheelchair-accessible staterooms designed for comfort and ease of movement. These staterooms typically feature wider doorways, additional floor space for maneuverability and accessible bathrooms with features such as roll-in showers and grab bars. Accessible cabins are limited and tend to book quickly, so it’s best to reserve early to ensure availability.

blocks.heading: Can I rent a wheelchair or mobility scooter onboard?
blocks.text: Wheelchairs and mobility scooters are not typically available for rent onboard. However, Princess works with approved third-party providers who can arrange delivery of mobility equipment directly to your ship. We recommend reserving any equipment in advance of your cruise to ensure availability and a smooth embarkation experience.

blocks.heading: Are all areas of the ship wheelchair accessible?
blocks.text: Many areas of the ship are wheelchair accessible, including staterooms, dining venues, theaters and outdoor spaces. Elevators provide access between decks to support easy navigation. blocks.text: Accessible transportation options may be available in select ports and for certain shore excursions, but availability can vary by destination. blocks.heading: Can I bring my own wheelchair or mobility scooter?
blocks.text: Yes, guests are welcome to bring their own wheelchairs or mobility scooters onboard. To ensure a smooth experience, we recommend confirming that your device fits within your stateroom and can be safely stored when not in use. Guests must contact the Access Office in advance so the team can plan accordingly and ensure all needs are met during your cruise. Please reach out to the Access Office at Ac

blocks.heading: What medical documentation should I bring with me?
blocks.text: It’s important to bring all necessary medical documentation to support a safe and comfortable journey. We recommend traveling with copies of your prescriptions, a list of medications (including dosages) and any relevant medical records or physician notes — especially if you have ongoing health conditions or require special equipment. If you use medical devices or injectable medications, documentat

blocks.heading: How far in advance should I notify the cruise line of medical needs?
blocks.text: If you have specific medical needs, it’s best to notify the cruise line as early as possible - ideally at the time of booking or at least several weeks before your departure. Providing advance notice allows the team to review your needs, confirm any necessary accommodations and help ensure appropriate arrangements are in place before you board.

blocks.heading: Can I bring over-the-counter medications onboard?
blocks.text: Yes, you can bring over-the-counter medications onboard for personal use. It’s a good idea to pack them in your carry-on luggage so they are easily accessible during embarkation and throughout your trip. Bringing enough to last the duration of your cruise is recommended.

blocks.heading: Are there limits on how much medication I can bring?
blocks.text: Guests are generally permitted to bring a reasonable supply of medications for personal use for the duration of their cruise. To avoid issues during travel, medications should be kept in their original labeled containers and packed in your carry-on luggage. If you are traveling internationally, it’s also recommended to check destination-specific regulations regarding certain medications.

blocks.heading: What happens if my medication is lost or runs out?
blocks.text: If your medication is lost or runs out during your cruise, visit the ship’s medical center as soon as possible. Medical staff may be able to assist with limited supplies or help coordinate next steps, depending on availability and your specific needs. However, not all medications may be available onboard or in port. To avoid disruptions, it’s strongly recommended to bring enough medication for you

blocks.heading: Can the ship accommodate special diets (gluten-free, diabetic, low-sodium)?
blocks.text: Yes, Princess offers a variety of options to accommodate special dietary needs, including gluten-free, diabetic-friendly, low-sodium, vegetarian and other medically or lifestyle-based diets. Dining teams work to provide suitable meal options across onboard restaurants. While availability may vary slightly by ship and itinerary, Princess strives to ensure guests with dietary needs can enjoy a comfo

blocks.heading: How do I notify the cruise line of dietary restrictions?
blocks.text: You can notify Princess of dietary restrictions through your booking or by contacting your Travel Advisor or the Princess Reservations team prior to your cruise. Once onboard, we recommend speaking with the dining staff to confirm your preferences and make any additional requests.

blocks.heading: Will I receive a refund if I cannot travel due to illness?
blocks.text: Refund eligibility depends on the terms of your booking and cancellation policy. If you need to cancel due to illness, standard cancellation policies will apply. In many cases, travel insurance may provide reimbursement for covered medical situations that prevent you from traveling. blocks.heading: Can I purchase urinary catheter supplies onboard?
blocks.text: Our ships stock a variety of urinary catheters; however, we strongly recommend that you bring an extra supply of catheters and any related supplies. If any difficulties are anticipated or encountered, you may be referred to a shoreside facility, if available.

blocks.heading: Can I take a cruise if I am pregnant?
blocks.text: You may only cruise if you have not entered the 24th week of pregnancy at any time during the voyage. You should travel with a letter from your physician stating that you and your baby are in good health and fit to travel. The letter should also include the estimated date of delivery and the results of any ultrasound studies performed.

blocks.heading: Can I travel with someone who has dementia?
blocks.text: The medical centers on board provide care for acute illnesses and injuries that may occur while on vacation and are not intended to provide long-term care for guests with chronic illnesses such as dementia. blocks.heading: Can I get wound care or dressing changes onboard?
blocks.text: Yes. Medical staff can provide routine wound care on board. Our ships stock a variety of dressings and wound care supplies. If specific, specialized dressings are required, we strongly recommend you bring these supplies with you. We also recommend you provide a letter from your healthcare provider detailing any specific wound care requirements.

blocks.heading: How can I dispose of medical waste onboard?
blocks.text: If you have a medical condition that requires disposal of medical waste products, notify your housekeeping steward upon embarkation. Biomedical waste bags will be provided for all medical waste.

blocks.heading: What do I do if I am feeling ill before boarding?
blocks.text: If you are feeling unwell with acute respiratory or gastrointestinal symptoms, please notify the check-in staff prior to embarkation. blocks.text: Our ships do not carry blood or blood products and do not routinely perform blood transfusions. However, in emergencies, a blood transfusion may be possible if a donor can be identified on board.

blocks.heading: Can the medical team assist me with my personal hygiene needs or activities of daily living (ADLs)?
blocks.text: The medical centers on board are intended to provide acute care for illness and injuries that may occur while on vacation and are not intended to provide long-term care for guests with chronic illnesses or as a substitute for regular health care. If you have a history of anaphylaxis, always have your EpiPen available.

blocks.heading: I have medication that requires refrigeration. Is this available on board?
blocks.text: Stateroom refrigerators are kept at about 37.4° to 45° Fahrenheit (or 3-7° Celsius) when the room is at an average temperature of approximately 77°F (or 25° C). blocks.heading: Can I bring onboard nutritional supplements or specific food, or drinks required for my medical condition?

blocks.text: Follow these important luggage reminders: Essential medicines, travel documents, valuables and breakables should be hand carried in your possession at all times. blocks.heading: Prescription Medication

blocks.heading: Valuables

blocks.heading: Multiple Excursions in One Port
blocks.text: If you choose to book more than one excursion in a single day, please allow at least 60 minutes between each excursion. All excursions depart from, and return to, the cruise ship pier. By scheduling in this manner, you will have sufficient time to take multiple excursions.

blocks.text: One very important feature of taking an excursion organized by Princess is that we closely monitor the departures and returns of all excursions. blocks.heading: Excursion Companies
blocks.text: All excursions are operated by local, independent companies and not by Princess. We selected only the most reputable companies available to provide your excursions. The companies providing your excursions are selected by Princess based on their excellent reputation for service and safety.

blocks.text: Select excursions offer child pricing. Our reservation system will automatically apply a child rate if one is available on eligible tours when you make your reservation. blocks.heading: Excursion Age Restrictions
blocks.text: For most excursions, there is no minimum age for children as long as they are accompanied by a parent or guardian. Guests under the age of 18 years cannot participate without a parent or guardian. A few operators may allow an unaccompanied minor on an excursion if a waiver is signed by the parent or guardian in the operator’s presence.

blocks.heading: Shopping

pages.title: Why Princess - Princess Cruises
pages.metaDescription: Discover why Princess Cruises offers an unforgettable cruise experience. Wherever you're headed, Princess Cruises makes choosing a cruise line easy.

headings.text: Experience the #1 cruise line in Alaska
You relax, we’ll handle the rest
The freedom to dine, sip, and indulge however you like
Level up the luxury with Sanctuary Collection℠ and Reserve Collection
Make every moment at sea unforgettable
Poolside is the place to be
Sail away on your dream vacation

blocks.heading: Celebrating 60 years of adventure
blocks.text: Since Princess first launched with a single ship sailing to Mexico in 1965, we’ve believed that cruising is something to celebrate. With 17 ships sailing to 345 destinations on 7 continents, world-class cuisine inspired by the places we visit, and the friendliest crew at sea—we’re ready to celebrate with you.

blocks.heading: Feel the “welcome aboard” warmth
blocks.text: Step on board and enter a world of ease. Every Princess MedallionClass® cruise is designed to make your vacation effortless, with an expert crew to attend to the details so you can simply enjoy the journey. With thoughtful service and a personal touch, cruising with Princess feels like coming home.

blocks.heading: Explore the world at sea
blocks.text: With cruises all over the world, on every continent—unpack once and visit the destinations you’ve dreamed of.

blocks.heading: View all destinations
blocks.text: Alaska Caribbean California View all destinations

blocks.heading: Experience the #1 cruise line in Alaska
blocks.text: Explore five stunning national parks on our Alaska cruises and cruisetours. Get up close to wildlife and discover the stories behind historic landmarks through unforgettable excursions.

blocks.heading: The friendliest service at sea
blocks.text: A warm smile with your morning coffee prepared just so. That extra something special on your birthday. Welcoming, attentive, and knowledgeable—each and every crew member is here for you, so you can just soak it all in.

blocks.heading: You relax, we’ll handle the rest
blocks.text: Need drinks while you lounge by the pool, or a late night snack? Your Medallion wearable device helps our crew find you so they can deliver personalized service.

blocks.heading: A celebration to remember
blocks.text: Birthdays, anniversaries, and more—our crew is here to make your special vacation more than memorable. While you’re with us, their stellar service ensures that you enjoy big ship amenities with a small ship feel.

blocks.heading: The freedom to dine, sip, and indulge however you like
blocks.text: No matter what you’re in the mood for, our chefs and mixologists serve up expertly crafted meals and beverages using fresh, local ingredients from the destinations we visit.

blocks.heading: Specialty restaurants
blocks.text: From aged and hand-cut steaks to handmade pasta made with treasured family recipes—our restaurants offer unique flavors for everyone.

blocks.heading: Experiential dining
blocks.text: Our immersive culinary experiences are designed to elevate your senses, awaken wonder, and transport you beyond the plate.

blocks.heading: Casual bites
blocks.text: Whether you want to grab a slice of handmade pizza before hitting the pool or sit down to savor a great burger, Princess offers a variety of casual dining experiences.

blocks.heading: Your retreat for ultimate relaxation
blocks.text: Our accommodations have everything you need to relax and unwind in your home away from home.

blocks.heading: Mini-suites
blocks.text: Mini-suites have many of the benefits of suites, such as a balcony and seating area, but in a smaller size.

blocks.heading: Balcony staterooms
blocks.text: Balcony staterooms include a private space to breathe the fresh open air at sea.

blocks.heading: Oceanview staterooms
blocks.text: Our oceanview staterooms offer stunning views of the sea.

blocks.heading: Level up the luxury with Sanctuary Collection℠ and Reserve Collection
Laughter, lights, and live shows
blocks.text: From dazzling musicals to laugh-out-loud comedy, Princess delivers world-class entertainment at sea—no matter what sort of fun you’re looking for.

blocks.heading: Laugh out loud comedy
blocks.text: Count on big laughs — thanks to stellar sets from acclaimed comedians on select cruises.

blocks.heading: Broadway-style shows
blocks.text: The spectacle of our Broadway-style shows offer entertainment at sea that you have to experience to believe.

blocks.heading: Incredible live music
blocks.text: Catch live DJs poolside, join in piano bar sing-alongs to end the night, or take in soothing guitar to start the day.

blocks.heading: Entertainers in The Piazza
blocks.text: The heart of the ship features exciting new performances every day. Dancing, acrobats, and even cocktail demonstrations.

blocks.heading: Game show excitement
blocks.text: Join in the game to win incredible prizes—and even a free cruise.

blocks.heading: Catch Movies Under the Stars®
blocks.text: Take in our giant 300-square foot poolside movie theater with a 69,000-watt sound system.

blocks.heading: Experience the magic
blocks.text: Prepare to be astonished by our renowned magicians and illusionists—and their mind-blowing acts—on select cruises.

blocks.heading: Make every moment at sea unforgettable
blocks.text: Whether you want to unwind and recharge or dive into non-stop fun, there’s something for everyone on board a Princess cruise.

blocks.heading: Poolside is the place to be
blocks.text: Take a dip in our sparkling pools or relaxing hot tubs and feel your shoulders drop.

blocks.heading: Connect with local culture

blocks.text: An easy and convenient way to travel New cruisers will find that the convenience of sailing can’t be beat. You'll experience the best of each region you visit while only unpacking once. blocks.text: Pack smart and dress right If you’re new to cruising, you might not know that there are sometimes dress codes, particularly for dining venues, as well as theme nights. Incredible accommodations
blocks.text: Unwind in incredible accommodations designed for comfort and luxury. Each stateroom provides a perfect retreat, with plush bedding, modern amenities and stunning ocean views to give first-time cruisers a restful and enjoyable stay.

blocks.heading: Meals
blocks.text: Take delight in a diverse culinary journey with complimentary meals. Princess offers a variety of delicious options, from gourmet restaurants to casual dining. Every meal is a memorable experience, whether you're enjoying exceptional cuisine crafted by world-class chefs or sharing a juicy burger by the pool with loved ones.

blocks.heading: Entertainment and activities
blocks.text: Experience nonstop fun with an exciting array of entertainment and activities, from Broadway-style shows and live music to thrilling onboard adventures and refreshing pools. There’s something for everyone, ensuring you’re always entertained and engaged.

blocks.heading: Kids clubs and family-friendly environments
blocks.text: Princess caters to families with dedicated kids clubs and family-friendly environments that offer age-appropriate activities and supervised programs. Kids and teens can enjoy their own spaces, where they'll make new friends and give parents time to relax.
